newsitem.title: USA: Dell servers, Americas, Euro sales jump.
newsitem.headline: Dell servers, Americas, Euro sales jump.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp on Tuesday said it posted sharp increases in sales in its Servers, Americas and European units in the third quarter ending October 27, 1996.

Dell said European sales rose by 41 percent from a year earlier to $482 million. Dell Americas recorded revenue growth of more than 35 percent with sales of $1.4 billion, driven by continued success with major corporate customers in the United States.
Strong third-quarter growth of both entry-level and mid-range network servers lifted server sales 137 percent over the same period last year.

Commenting in a release on the results, Mort Topfer, Dell vice chairman said, "We have solidified our position as the second largest PC company in the British market," said "Our other major European businesses, especially Germany and France, also continued to show impressive growth."
He added, "We are maintaining an aggressive pricing strategy (in the network server market)...and we will continue to pursue a price/performance leadership role."
